 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence with caution 
marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety helmet, shoes and 
 safety clothes ... etc.

Isolate the rectifier out of 
 service and earth.

The presence of current in load 
 is signaled by flashing caution lamp and a display segment.
Screw driver set, Air Blower
Screw driver set, Air Blower
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes.

Portable earth discharging test 
 loads

Through cleaning of all power semi conductors 
 and of all control P.C. boards, remove foreign matter, if any.

Check of tightness of all electrical and 
 mechanical connections.

Check that all P.C. boards are correctly plugged 
 in their seats and that electromechanical components are well seated on their 
 bases.

Check that all vents be clean "remove possible 
 digging material"

Check that there is no 
 condensate build up or water seepage.

Check that all 
 signals and instruments furnish the correct indication.

Check the 
 correct operation of the system and/or equipment in the correct entirely.

Check the 
 setting value.

If there are 
 any failures in the equipment, check that all input and output voltages do 
 correspond to the equipment plate rating, then, check possible alarm 
 indication on the board front.

Check that 
 there is no condensate build up or water seepage.

Checkout of 
 the batteries.

Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
visual inspection list I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated 
by M6 in the title block.
This first draft is initiated by eng. Sami 
Hasan and tested by eng. Sayed El-Ashry, revised by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Tawfik El-abasery, and approved by general manager eng. 
Mohamed abd Elghaffar.
